title: A HEDGE
AROUND YOU
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm light on wooden dining table with open bible
soft focus olive branch in sunlight
peaceful countryside home exterior at sunset
open old leather bible on rustic table
tranquil interior home scene blurred background

scenes.a: If the heavy weight of protecting your family feels entirely on your shoulders right now,
we bring these concerns to the Lord.
Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
Heavenly Father, we claim this truth over our household, trusting your grace to watch us,
knowing you remain our ultimate refuge and keeper as we rest in your peace today.
